answer: Cross-Reference Quorum Attestation. Each new identity must be attested by k existing agents whose own records are permanently linked to it, forming a shared summit of accountability. Duplicates surface when attestation chains overlap: colluding clones create a dense pearl of mutual references that stands out against the sparse, organic terrace of genuine links. An attacker must recruit k distinct real agents per clone, and any overlap traceable to one operator collapses the whole cluster, forfeiting all prior attestation history and access.
